name: Industrial Bank (Xingye) Gui'an New Area Data Center
notes: Located at Machang Industrial New City, Gui'an New Area. Phase 1 main building topped out 2025-08 (China Construction First Group); total investment ~RMB 6.88 bn, ~266 mu, 26.1 wan sqm, planned 18,000 racks supporting 200,000 servers. 2024-11-29 Guiyang Daily reported construction launch. Capacity 108 MW = 18,000 racks x 6 kW (design).

name: Bank of Communications (Jiaotong) Gui'an Data Center
notes: Gui'an New Area project filed/approved for establishment 2023-03; phase 1 main structure topped out 2025-01-10. Planned ~279 mu, ~RMB 5 bn investment, 10,000+ racks, 200,000+ servers. Capacity 60 MW = 10,000 racks x 6 kW (design, phase 1+).

name: SPIC (State Power Investment) Gui'an Data Center Phase 1
developer: SPIC (Gui'an New Area) Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Phase 1 building area 14,035.26 sqm (A3 data-center building ~14,000 sqm), part of SPIC's power-industry digital chain; 2023-10 reporting said construction in full swing to relocate SPIC Beijing data center workloads to Gui'an by 2023-11. SPIC Gui'an Data Center Co. registered capital raised to RMB 298 mn (2026-04). No rack/MW disclosed.

name: Gui'an Midea Cloud Data Center Phase 1
notes: Phase 1 (A building + campus supporting works incl. diesel platform & gatehouse) total area 15,415.96 sqm; single data building can host 1,200 x 8kW racks / 70,000+ servers. Planned total investment ~RMB 1.355 bn; opened/commissioned by 2024 with reported operating PUE ~1.17. Listed among Gui'an DC cluster projects completing 2023. Capacity 9.6 MW = 1,200 racks x 8 kW (phase 1 design).

name: Southern Energy Big Data Center (CSG Digital Industry Eco-Park)
notes: Groundbreaking 2023-06-17 in Gui'an New Area; total investment RMB 1.45 bn, ~133.8 mu, total plan ~5,000 x 10kW racks hosting ~100,000 1U servers, PUE <=1.2; phase 1 ~RMB 800 mn for 2,000 x 10kW racks, 3-5 yr build. Part of China Southern Power Grid digital industry ecosystem park. Capacity 50 MW = 5,000 racks x 10 kW (total plan).

name: National Integrated Computing Network Guizhou Hub Node - Main Compute Base
developer: Guizhou provincial hub operator (Guizhou Big Data / state platform)
notes: Guizhou hub node project: total investment ~RMB 1 bn; 'one center + one base': dispatch center 11,700 sqm and main compute base 16,900 sqm; total compute 274P (general+intelligent+HPC) with 33P distributed storage, >60% domestic hardware coverage. Phase 1 56PFlops intelligent-compute equipment built and in use (2023). Capacity 13.7 MW = 274 PFlops x 0.05 MW (compute-derived).

name: China Unicom Gui'an Cloud Data Center Phase II
notes: Phase II of China Unicom (Gui'an) cloud data center: by Feb 2024 main structure, heating, utilities and decoration completed, handover targeted H2 2024; listed as 'East-Data-West-Computing' efficient scheduling demonstration and provincial key project. Racks planned to grow from ~4,000+ to ~10,000 after phase II. Capacity 60 MW = 10,000 racks x 6 kW (design). Same operator as existing Unicom Gui'an entry - phase II expansion.

name: China Construction Bank (CCB) Gui'an Data Center
notes: CCB data center & big-data application demonstration base to land in Guiyang/Gui'an with reported total investment RMB 32.3 bn (includes group subsidiary park development); CCB also pushing subsidiaries into Gui'an and channeling overseas funds via CCB International. No rack/MW disclosed; capacity 646 MW is investment-derived (32.3 x 2 MW/100 mn RMB) and includes non-DC development - treat as upper-bound proxy.

name: PBOC Clearing Center Gui'an (payment/clearing data center)
developer: People's Bank of China / payment & clearing institutions
notes: PBoC positioning payment, clearing, settlement, credit and AML financial infrastructure in Guiyang/Gui'an; 12+ payment/clearing institutions' real-time compute data centers expected to land inside the PBoC Gui'an data center. Capacity not disclosed.

name: JD.com Gui'an Data Center
notes: Signed at 2021 Guizhou Big Data Expo (Shubo Hui) as part of Gui'an New Area big-data project package. No rack/MW or construction status found in public sources.

name: Gui'an Puhui Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Signed at 2021 Guizhou Big Data Expo as Gui'an New Area big-data project; no capacity or status publicly disclosed.

name: Guiyang-Gui'an Data Center Innovation Center
notes: Signed at 2021 Guizhou Big Data Expo as part of Gui'an New Area big-data project package; no capacity or status publicly disclosed.

name: China Telecom Gui'an Intelligent Computing Center (10k-card plan)
notes: China Telecom intelligent-computing center project in Gui'an planned as 10,000-card intelligent computing center, disclosed in 2023-2024 Gui'an cluster reporting; distinct from China Telecom Guizhou Information Park storage DC (existing entry). No MW disclosed.

name: Enflame (Suanyuan) Intelligent Computing Center, Gui'an
notes: Enflame intelligent-computing center landed in Gui'an New Area in 2023 (year called 'smart-computing first year' for Guizhou), per Gui'an cluster reporting. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Gui'an Rendering Intelligent Computing Center & Digital Culture Content Base
notes: Rendering intelligent-computing center plus digital culture content production base unveiled (licensed) in Gui'an New Area 2023. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Huawei Cloud Gui'an AI Computing Center (Ascend deployment)
notes: re-verified: Huawei Cloud Gui'an intelligent computing center (part of existing Huawei Gui'an campus entry) reported to have deployed over 110,000 Ascend NPUs by end-Oct 2024; Ascend AI cloud service launched on the Gui'an AI compute center. No MW figure disclosed in source.
